messages:
maya: Quick sync — we need to lock console/observability scope for Q4. Customers keep asking for longer retention + trace search. Thoughts?

sam: Agree. Top asks: 1) configurable retention tiers (90/365/3y) 2) trace span search across requests 3) alert noise reduction by better error grouping :loud_sound:

dylan: For retention, budget is the blocker. Storage cost scales nonlinearly. We should propose hot=90d, cold=1y default for hosted, enterprise opt-in for 3y.

eva-ux: UI implication: we can't surface 3 tiers without clear defaults. Need telemetry to show how often users query >90d before we default to extended.

maya: OKR alignment — Product OKR 1.2: Reduce customer escalations for observability by 40%. Proposed launch criteria: (a) per-route dashboard for p50/p95 latency + token-cost, (b) trace search for sampled spans, (c) retention opt-in UI, (d) regression tests on ingestion throughput.

ariel: Technical constraints: trace search requires index (ES/OLAP) or a span vector store. MVP = limited full-text on span message + tags, with 24h indexing lag for >7d windows.

sam: Can we scope the initial dashboard widgets to: latency heatmap, token-cost by route, error-rate trend, and top error traces? Keep advanced trace search for post-beta.

maya: That seems reasonable. Let's capture launch acceptance criteria as checklist:
- dashboards: latency heatmap, per-route token-cost, error trends [owner: sam]
- trace search MVP: tag + message search, 24h indexing delay for older ranges [owner: dylan]
- retention: UI opt-in + billing estimate calc [owner: liz]
- QA load tests: ingest 10k req/s sample traces with no >2% drop [owner: eng-sre]

liz: I'll own billing calc. Need a sample pricing calc: storage $/GB-month + query cost. I'll draft tomorrow.

dylan: On the infra side, we'll need a sampling knob per-namespace to keep costs down; prefix/KV caching churn can create a lot of spans.

maya: Launch timeline candidate: feature-flagged alpha by Nov 15, public beta Dec 15, general availability Jan 31. Is that realistic? (Q4 -> GA early Q1)

sam: Tight but doable if we trim scope. Recommend pushing trace search GA to Feb to avoid crunch.

ariel: Risks: retention + legal (CCPA) data deletion, export flows for customers. Add compliance review to pre-GA checklist.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: staging build 2026-11-02T13:12:00Z for branch feat/obs-retention deployed to staging-observability

eva-ux: For UX, we need user flows for retention toggles and billing preview. I'll mock in next 5 days.

maya: Actions:
- liz: pricing calc by 1778260000
- sam: dashboard alpha widgets by 1778240000
- dylan: trace search MVP infra plan by 1778235000
- ariel: compliance checklist by 1778250000
- eva-ux: mockups by 1778230000
I'll follow up with a 1:1 sync tomorrow. :thumbsup:

maya: Thanks all — trying to avoid bloated GA scope. We'll keep the extra features on a post-GA roadmap bucket.
